017package org.apache.juneau.marshall.parser;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020
021import java.io.*;
022import java.nio.charset.*;
023
024import org.apache.juneau.commons.collections.*;
025
026/**
027 * Subclass of parser session objects for character-based parsers.
028 *
029 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
030 *    <li class='warn'>This class is not thread safe and is typically discarded after one use.
031 * </ul>
032 *
033 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
034 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/SerializersAndParsers">Serializers and Parsers</a>
035 * </ul>
036 */
037@SuppressWarnings({
038   "java:S115" // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention
039})
040public class ReaderParserSession extends ParserSession {
041
042   // Property name constants
043   private static final String PROP_streamCharset = "streamCharset";
044   private static final String PROP_ReaderParserSession_streamCharset = "ReaderParserSession.streamCharset";
045
046   // Argument name constants for assertArgNotNull
047   private static final String ARG_ctx = "ctx";
048
049   /**
050    * Builder class.
051    */
052   @SuppressWarnings({
053      "java:S119" // 'SELF' (CRTP self-type) is intentional and clearer than a single-letter name.
054   })
055   public abstract static class Builder<SELF extends Builder<SELF>> extends ParserSession.Builder<SELF> {
056
057      private Charset streamCharset;
058      private ReaderParser ctx;
059
060      /**
061       * Constructor
062       *
063       * @param ctx The context creating this session.
064       *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
065       */
066      protected Builder(ReaderParser ctx) {
067         super(assertArgNotNull(ARG_ctx, ctx));
068         this.ctx = ctx;
069         streamCharset = ctx.getStreamCharset();
070      }
071
072      @Override
073      public ReaderParserSession build() {
074         return new ReaderParserSession(this);
075      }
076
077      @Override /* Overridden from Builder */
078      public SELF property(String key, Object value) {
079         if (key == null) {
080            super.property(key, value);
081            return self();
082         }
083         switch (key) {
084            case PROP_streamCharset, PROP_ReaderParserSession_streamCharset:
085               return streamCharset(cvt(value, Charset.class));
086            default:
087               super.property(key, value);
088               return self();
089         }
090      }
091
092      /**
093       * Input stream charset.
094       *
095       * <p>
096       * The character set to use for converting InputStreams and byte arrays to readers.
097       *
098       * <p>
099       * Used when passing in input streams and byte arrays to {@link Parser#read(Object, Class)}.
100       *
101       * <p>
102       * If not specified, defaults to UTF-8.
103       *
104       * @param value
105       *    The new property value.
106       *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (defaults to UTF-8).
107       * @return This object.
108       */
109      public SELF streamCharset(Charset value) {
110         streamCharset = value;
111         return self();
112      }
113
114   }
115
116   /**
117    * Concrete default builder leaf for the non-subclassed {@code create()} path (CRTP terminal).
118    */
119   public static final class DefaultBuilder extends Builder<DefaultBuilder> {
120
121      DefaultBuilder(ReaderParser ctx) {
122         super(ctx);
123      }
124   }
125
126   /**
127    * Creates a new builder for this object.
128    *
129    * @param ctx The context creating this session.
130    *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
131    * @return A new builder.
132    */
133   @SuppressWarnings({
134      "java:S1452" // Builder<?> wildcard return intentional; callers use it to construct session instances polymorphically
135   })
136   public static Builder<?> create(ReaderParser ctx) {
137      return new DefaultBuilder(assertArgNotNull(ARG_ctx, ctx));
138   }
139
140   private final ReaderParser ctx;
141   private final Charset streamCharset;
142
143   /**
144    * Constructor.
145    *
146    * @param builder The builder for this object.
147    *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
148    */
149   protected ReaderParserSession(Builder<?> builder) {
150      super(builder);
151      ctx = builder.ctx;
152      streamCharset = builder.streamCharset;
153   }
154
155   /**
156    * Wraps the specified input object into a {@link ParserPipe} object so that it can be easily converted into
157    * a stream or reader.
158    *
159    * @param input
160    *    The input.
161    *    <br>This can be any of the following types:
162    *    <ul>
163    *       <li><jk>null</jk>
164    *       <li>{@link Reader}
165    *       <li>{@link CharSequence}
166    *       <li>{@link InputStream} containing UTF-8 encoded text (or whatever the encoding specified by
167    *          {@link ReaderParser.Builder#streamCharset(Charset)}).
168    *       <li><code><jk>byte</jk>[]</code> containing UTF-8 encoded text (or whatever the encoding specified by
169    *          {@link ReaderParser.Builder#streamCharset(Charset)}).
170    *    </ul>
171    * @return
172    *    A new {@link ParserPipe} wrapper around the specified input object.
173    */
174   @SuppressWarnings({
175      "resource" // Resource management handled by ParserPipe
176   })
177   @Override /* Overridden from ParserSesson */
178   public final ParserPipe createPipe(Object input) {
179      return setPipe(new ParserPipe(input, isDebug(), true, ctx.isAutoCloseStreams(), ctx.isUnbuffered(), streamCharset));
180   }
181
182   /**
183    * Returns the stream charset defined on this session.
184    *
185    * @return the stream charset defined on this session.
186    */
187   public Charset getStreamCharset() { return streamCharset; }
188
189   @Override /* Overridden from ParserSession */
190   public final boolean isReaderParser() { return true; }
191
192   @Override /* Overridden from ParserSession */
193   protected FluentMap<String,Object> properties() {
194      return super.properties()
195         .a(PROP_streamCharset, streamCharset);
196   }
197}
